==Notes==
{{anomaly|Unlike most [[List of adrenaline-related skills#Skills that multiply adrenaline gain|skills that increase the rate of adrenaline gain by a multiplier]], this increases all non-multiplier sources of adrenaline, not just the basic 1 strike from making an attack.}}
*Focused Anger will not [[Effect stacking|stack]] with other skills to bring your total adrenaline gain above 100%; however, if you have more than 100% gain from Focused Anger, you will still gain that amount.
*Because adrenal gain is done on a point system, with some units smaller than a strike, it can often be difficult to tell how much impact this skill will make when charging adrenaline skills. 
*Commonly used as the elite for [[Imbagon]]s.
